```artifact
Feature: System Usability and Documentation

  Scenario: Non-technical users can complete a Consultation Request within 5 minutes
    Given a user with no computer background
    When the user initiates a Consultation Request
    And the system presents only minimal and relevant questions
    Then the user should be able to complete the request in less than 5 minutes

  Scenario: System navigation is simple and intuitive
    Given a user with no computer background
    When the user navigates through the system's main menu
    Then the user should reach any desired feature in no more than 3 clicks

  Scenario: Installation Guide is prepared
    Given the system requires installation
    When the installation guide is accessed
    Then the guide should contain step-by-step instructions for downloading, extracting, and running the installation script

  Scenario: User Manual is prepared
    Given the system is installed and running
    When the user manual is accessed
    Then the manual should contain clear instructions for using the system

  Scenario Outline: Installation process verification
    Given the installation package is downloaded
    When the package is extracted
    And the installation script is executed
    Then the installation should complete without errors
    Examples:
      | download_status | extract_status | install_status |
      | downloaded      | extracted      | completed      |
      | error           | -              | -              |
      | timeout         | -              | -              |

  Scenario: Error path during installation
    Given an invalid installation package
    When the package is attempted to be extracted
    Then an error message should be displayed indicating extraction failure
```
